notes: Fixtures are real Git repositories built by build_fixtures.py, so state assertions are checkable against git. Assertions avoid length caps deliberately: proportionality is judged by repetition and restated source material, not character count. Each block should appear in exactly one document.

evals.name: daily-midfeature
evals.prompt:
/handoff

Project root is PROJECT_PATH. Today's session is written up in SESSION-NOTES.md at the repo root — that's the whole session, I'm not retyping it. Wrap it up so I can pick this straight back up tomorrow without rereading any of it.
evals.expected_output: One dated Daily Handoff under docs/handoffs/ recording the two commits on feat/rate-limit, the staged/unstaged/untracked split, no upstream, the middleware-over-gateway decision with rationale, nginx as a closed approach with its reason, the burst allowance as blocked on Priya, tests as not run, and an executable next action. No Master file created.
assertions: Creates exactly one file matching docs/handoffs/YYYY-MM-DD_NNN_<scope>-handoff.md
Does not create or modify docs/handoffs/_master-handoff.md
Names branch feat/rate-limit and the correct HEAD commit hash
Reports uncommitted work, distinguishing staged (src/config/limits.ts) from unstaged (src/server.ts) from untracked (notes/scratch.txt)
States that the branch has no upstream, or that the work is unpushed
Records the decision to implement rate limiting as application middleware, with the per-API-key rationale
Records the gateway/nginx approach as rejected, with the reason (nginx cannot see the API key)
Does not claim the test suite was run or passed; test status appears as not run
Burst allowance is recorded as unimplemented and blocked on Priya's answer about pricing tiers
The immediate next action is executable from the described state and names a file, command, or person
Every commit hash, file path, and branch name in the document exists in the fixture repository
No claim of a PR, issue, deployment, build, or approval that does not exist in the fixture
src/config/limits.ts values are described as provisional or unconfirmed, not as final
No section headings left with placeholder or 'N/A' content

evals.name: master-update-stale-claims
evals.prompt:
/handoff master

Project root is PROJECT_PATH. The Master handoff hasn't been touched since June and a couple of sessions happened after it. Bring it up to date.
evals.expected_output: The existing docs/handoffs/_master-handoff.md updated in place: stale claims corrected (feat/pdf-render deleted, tests moved out of the repo so the 24-passing claim is superseded, HEAD is feat/invoice-totals), both unincorporated Dailies folded in, the numbering decision preserved, headless Chrome recorded as do-not-repeat, and the incorporated table updated. No second Master file.
assertions: docs/handoffs/_master-handoff.md is modified in place; no second Master file is created under any name
Version is incremented above 2.0 and Last Updated is changed
The claim 'Test status: passing (tests/invoice.spec.ts, 24 tests)' is corrected or superseded rather than carried forward
Records that the test suite moved to the QA repository and that two tests were failing at the move
The deleted feat/pdf-render branch is no longer presented as active work
Current technical state names the actual current branch (feat/invoice-totals) and its HEAD
The per-tenant invoice numbering decision from the 2026-05-30 Daily is preserved, not dropped
Headless Chrome appears as a rejected approach with its measured reason (image size / cold start)
Both 2026-06-20 and 2026-06-24 Dailies are listed as incorporated in the Master's table
Claims that could not be verified this session are labelled (for example staging deployment status), not restated as fact
Open PR #38 is either verified, marked unverified, or corrected — not silently repeated as current
No invented facts: no owner, approval, precedence rule, test result, issue, or deployment that appears in no input
The immediate next action is executable from the current branch state
Full session narrative from the Dailies is not copied into the Master; the Master states consequences and points at the Daily files

evals.name: full-handover-blocked
evals.prompt:
/handoff full

Project root is PROJECT_PATH. I'm handing this off — I'm out for two weeks and someone else is taking it over cold. Session notes are in SESSION-NOTES.md.
evals.expected_output: A dated Daily plus a new Master (v1.0). Daily holds the session narrative, the afternoon lost to the raw-body constraint, and repo state; Master holds the durable constraint, the blocker, sources, and the next action. The next action is obtaining the signing secret from Dana. Signature verification is labelled untested. No block appears in full in both documents.
assertions: Creates one dated Daily Handoff and one docs/handoffs/_master-handoff.md
Master is Version 1.0 and states its own canonical path

Signature verification is never presented as working or verified. Note the session notes claim it was written and committed while the diff of the HEAD commit changes comment lines only; either outcome passes -- recording it as implemented-but-untested, or catching the contradiction and recording it as not implemented -- but claiming it works does not
The blocker is the partner's signing secret, and the immediate next action is obtaining it from Dana / the partner's integrations team
The raw-body-before-JSON-parser constraint is recorded as a durable constraint
'Do not rewrite src/verify.ts' is preserved as work that must not be repeated
States that nothing is deployed and no PR exists, or marks those as not verified
Names branch feat/signature-verify and the correct HEAD commit
No invented facts: no test result, approval, owner, issue, deployment, or precedence rule absent from the inputs
The risk/constraint register appears in the Master; the Daily does not repeat it in full
Work-that-must-not-be-repeated, sources of truth, and the next-action block each appear in full in only one of the two documents
The Daily's session narrative (the afternoon lost to the raw-body issue) is not copied into the Master; the Master keeps only the constraint
Both documents are independently understandable: the Daily identifies the project and branch, the Master states current state without requiring the Daily
Neither document restates SESSION-NOTES.md wholesale
